_readme: SPYPUNK card database. One entry per card; the deck is one copy of each.
cost ($ to deploy), top/bottom (edge symbol of each domino half:
muscle|intel|favor|credit|whisper — assigned per card to fit the card's
name/flavor; duplicates like favor/favor are allowed), kind: 'I' instant /
'O' ongoing, text (rules text shown in UI),
spec: machine-readable effect (parameterized primitive, or a custom op
implemented in src/game/effects.ts / src/game/ongoing.ts keyed by that op),
disabled: set true to bench a broken effect mid-playtest. A disabled card
stays in the deck and works on the grid (symbols, points) but cannot be
deployed and its Ongoing/Instant effect never fires.
NOTE: there is NO pts field. A card's point value derives from its two
symbols: pts = SYMBOL_VP[top] + SYMBOL_VP[bottom], with SYMBOL_VP in
at load time in src/game/cards.ts. Changing a card's symbols changes its
To add a card: pick a free id, set the fields above, and give it a spec —
reuse an existing spec op if one fits (see the HOW TO ADD AN EFFECT guide
at the top of src/game/effects.ts for the full recipe).

cards.name: Silent Needle
cards.text: Remove 2 influence from one card.

cards.name: Rooftop Ghost
cards.text: Remove 1 influence from each of two different cards.

cards.name: Poison Kiss
cards.text: Remove 1 influence from a card, then add 1 of yours to that card.

cards.name: The Cleaner
cards.text: Remove up to 3 influence belonging to one player from one card.

cards.name: Double Tap
cards.text: Remove 1 influence from a card. If the card is now empty, gain $2.

cards.name: Guild Mentor
cards.text: Your Muscle matches remove 2 influence instead of 1.

cards.name: Sleeper Agent
cards.text: When you place an Assassin on the grid, you may remove 1 influence from a card adjacent to it.

cards.name: Night Contract
cards.text: At the start of your turn, you may remove 1 influence from a card holding 4+ influence.

cards.name: Untouchable
cards.text: Opponents' Muscle matches cannot remove your influence.

cards.name: Vendetta
cards.text: Whenever any of your influence is removed, gain $1.

cards.name: Kneecapper
cards.text: Remove 1 influence from any card.

cards.name: Debt Collector
cards.text: Remove 1 influence from a card; that token's owner pays you $1 (if able).

cards.name: Street Sweep
cards.text: Choose a row or column; remove 1 influence from up to 3 cards in it.

cards.name: Show of Force
cards.text: Add 2 of your influence to a card that already holds your influence.

cards.name: Protection Racket
cards.text: At the start of your turn, gain $1 if you are the only player with influence on 2+ cards.

cards.name: Union Boss
cards.text: Enforcers you place enter with 1 extra of your influence.

cards.name: Bouncer
cards.text: Opponents cannot move influence off cards where you have 2+ influence.

cards.name: Made Man
cards.text: At the start of your turn, you may add 1 of your influence to a card that already holds your influence.

cards.name: Leg Breaker
cards.text: Remove 1 influence from a card adjacent to the card you placed most recently.

cards.name: The Wall
cards.text: Your influence cannot be removed from cards where you have 3+ influence.

cards.name: Whip Count
cards.text: Add 1 of your influence to each of two adjacent cards.

cards.name: Earmark
cards.text: Gain $2.

cards.name: Filibuster
cards.text: Choose a card; influence cannot be added to, removed from, or moved off it until your next turn.

cards.name: Landslide
cards.text: Add 3 of your influence to one card.

cards.name: Pork Barrel
cards.text: Add 1 of your influence to a card and gain $1.

cards.name: Committee Chair
cards.text: Your Favor matches may add the influence to the matched neighbor instead of your placed card.

cards.name: Party Leader
cards.text: Whenever a card is scored and you have influence on it, gain $1.

cards.name: Incumbent
cards.text: You win influence ties when cards are scored.

cards.name: Lobbyist Liaison
cards.text: Your Credit matches earn $2 instead of $1.

cards.name: Kingmaker
cards.text: Whenever you score a card alone (not tied), score 1 extra point.

cards.name: Margin Call
cards.text: Gain $3.

cards.name: Insider Tip
cards.text: Draw 2 cards (hand limit 6).

cards.name: Hostile Takeover
cards.text: Move up to 2 influence (any owners) from one card to an adjacent card.

cards.name: Arbitrage
cards.text: Gain $1 for each Broker on the grid (max $4).

cards.name: Escrow Raid
cards.text: Each opponent pays you $1 (if able).

cards.name: Venture Angel
cards.text: Your deploy costs are reduced by $1 (minimum 0).

cards.name: Hedge Fund
cards.text: At the start of your turn, gain $1.

cards.name: Market Maker
cards.text: Whenever an opponent triggers a Credit match, you also gain $1.

cards.name: Portfolio Hedge
cards.text: Whenever a card is scored and you have no influence on it, gain $1.

cards.name: Short Seller
cards.text: Whenever a Muscle match removes influence, gain $1.

cards.name: Backdoor
cards.text: Add 1 of your influence to any card on the grid.

cards.name: Open Feed
cards.text: Opponents' hands are visible to you.

cards.name: Botnet
cards.text: Add 1 of your influence to each of up to two cards that already hold your influence.

cards.name: Ransomware
cards.text: Choose an opponent: they either pay you $2 or you remove 2 of their influence from one card.

cards.name: Spoof
cards.text: Move 1 influence (any owner) from a card to an adjacent card.

cards.name: Zero Day
cards.text: Choose a card on the grid; trigger both of its edge symbols as if you had just matched them.

cards.name: Firewall
cards.text: Opponents' Whisper matches cannot move your influence.

cards.name: Deep Scan
cards.text: When you place a Hacker, look at the top 3 cards of the deck and return them in any order.

cards.name: Grid Worm
cards.text: Your Intel matches add 1 influence to your placed card as well as the matched neighbor.

cards.name: Ghost Protocol
cards.text: Your Whisper matches may move 2 influence instead of 1.

cards.name: Gala Invitation
cards.text: Move up to 2 of your influence from one card to an adjacent card.

cards.name: Charm Offensive
cards.text: Replace 1 opponent influence on a card with 1 of yours.

cards.name: Scandal
cards.text: Choose a card; every player with influence on it removes 1 of their own.

cards.name: Wingman
cards.text: Add 1 of your influence to a card adjacent to any Socialite.

cards.name: Masquerade
cards.text: Swap 1 influence on a card with 1 influence on an adjacent card (one each way).

cards.name: It Couple
cards.text: When you place a card adjacent to a Socialite, your placed card enters with 1 extra of your influence.

cards.name: Salon Host
cards.text: At the start of your turn, you may move 1 of your influence to an adjacent card.

cards.name: Rumor Mill
cards.text: Your Whisper matches may move influence between any two adjacent cards, not just the matched pair.

cards.name: Confidant
cards.text: Whenever an opponent deploys a card, gain $1.

cards.name: Center of Attention
cards.text: At the start of your turn, if you have influence on 5+ cards, gain $2.
